direction.description: the railroad-review direction this lane walked

lane.description: this lane's 1-based index within its direction

aborted.description: true when the premise check failed and the lane stopped without reviewing — an aborted lane never counts as a finished review

artifact_json.description: absolute path of the JSON findings artifact written under the round dir

checkout_sha.description: full HEAD SHA of the lane worktree, from git rev-parse after the SECOND ACTION pin — recorded in the artifact JSON too

overlay_ok.description: overlay runs only: true exactly when git apply -R --check of the review-context overlay exits 0 in the lane worktree — recorded in the artifact JSON too

walk_complete.description: true exactly when the artifact's walk_complete flag was accepted by the read-gate — every checklist pair answered

walk_open.description: number of checklist pairs (file × group, or group) still without a walk entry; 0 when complete

claim_refs.description: one ref per finding in the artifact — everything the pipeline computes on; the write-up (claim, evidence) stays in the artifact file

severity.description: the severity-table row for effect/exposure; INFO exactly when fix is "none" — recomputed at dedup entry

fix.description: the concrete fix, one sentence or a short diff sketch; "none" for INFO

checklist.description: the checklist item this finding answers — a context entry id on rule directions, <direction>-<n> on correctness and contracts

notes.description: missing context files, excluded scope, anomalies
